description: Bridge system outside current benchmark scope
message: Build a full bridge model for a three-span continuous girder bridge, including moving vehicle loads and support settlement.

assertions.description: The agent must explicitly state that the currently available StructureClaw skills or adapters cannot faithfully model and execute the requested bridge workflow with moving vehicle loads and support settlement, and it must refuse to build or analyze it before solver execution. It may propose a supported simplification or an external bridge-analysis workflow. Merely asking for more bridge geometry, material, or load data does not satisfy this criterion.
